Subject: SparkBridge testimonial — draft for your edit pass

Hi Lena,

Thanks again for agreeing to do this — attached is a third draft of the SparkBridge testimonial (sparkbridge-case-draft-v3.docx). We tightened the narrative around the integration timeline and the cost/latency improvements you shared during the call.

Quick notes on items we expect you might want to adjust:
- The opening metric ("~40% reduction in inference cost") — we used the number from your Q2 report; please correct if you prefer a different framing.
- Quoted line attributed to Rahul (CTO) is draft language; feel free to replace with Rahul's exact phrasing.
- Logos & legal: we left a brief placeholder for "SparkBridge logo" and added the standard release blurb.

Can you: 1) review for factual accuracy and 2) either upload your redlines to the same Drive link or send a marked PDF? We can expedite legal if there are logo/brand rules.

I cc'd Marissa (content ops) and Ben (customer success) so they can see any edits and confirm the final quote and metrics.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that's faster.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: sparkbridge-case-draft-v3.docx (draft doc)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@sparkbridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: SparkBridge Marketing <marketing@sparkbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SparkBridge testimonial — draft for your edit pass

Hi Olga,

Thanks — received and reviewed with the team. Overall this reads well. A few factual corrections and one wording request from legal:

Redlines (attached): sparkbridge-redlines-olga.pdf
- The cost reduction should be "~38%" not 40% — our benchmark excludes one-time migration credits.
- Please remove the sentence that implies SparkBridge changed deployment architecture; we only modified routing rules in our control plane.
- Suggested quote from Rahul: "Redwood reduced our inference cost and made deployment predictable across our fleet."

Legal request: change the release blurb to the short form provided in the attachment; they prefer no year references in the opening paragraph.

We can approve once the doc reflects the 38% metric, the architecture language is corrected, and the quote is updated. If you want signoff on the final PDF, I can route to legal quickly.

If helpful, I can also provide a high-resolution logo (PNG) via email.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Demand Gen
SparkBridge
lena.ortiz@sparkbridge.com

Attachment: sparkbridge-redlines-olga.pdf (annotated review)
